procedure.method: Read only the explicitly allowed pinned inputs and checked their byte hashes. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty; there were no separate source assets to view or protected-layout manifests to read. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following embedded paths. Actually inspected the exact poster images via tools.view_image with detail=original, returning each image through functions.exec for visual inspection. Five ordered calls each awaited and emitted native, usage720, then thumbnail320 for M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, matching packet order. All 15 initial views were inspected before the first transcription comparison, image score or diversity score. Then recorded the first raw text reads and evaluated all seven dimensions independently. A genuine M3 time-separator ambiguity triggered one additional tools.view_image call on the identical pinned M3 native; both reads are retained and the ambiguity remains unresolved. viewed_count and viewed describe the 15 required initial views; the extra revisit is recorded separately. Actual PNG IHDR dimensions were checked without resizing or modifying images. No trace/session ID or external tool serialization is claimed; session_id is null for runner binding.
